about:
Twenty-one ratings from Table 31.5 of the Spanish edition: a 190 mm wall of normal-weight concrete blocks, bare and under six ways of mounting 16 mm plasterboard, with and without glass fibre filling the cavities, on one side or on both. The page prints seven mountings as rows and four columns under two spanning headings ("Sin fibra de vidrio" and "Con fibra de vidrio", each over "Un lado" and "Ambos lados"); each printed cell is a row here, with the mounting as the name and the column as the variant.

Seven cells are blank on the page, with no dash and no note: the bare blocks print only the first column, "Aplicada directamente" prints nothing with glass fibre, and "Cubierta flexible de 75 mm" prints nothing on both sides. A blank cell is a configuration the page does not rate, so it has no row here.

One printed rating is lower on both sides than on one: "Canales flexibles de 13 mm" with glass fibre prints 54 on one side and 49 on both. It is held as printed; the page gives no reason, and nothing on it says the number is wrong.
